title: Ancient temples dismantled and items removed

tellings.quote: certain ancient temples that have been dismantled and things that have been removed and I have found very very compelling evidence that that it's happened

plain: Certain ancient temples, in the region around Lake Van in Turkey, were deliberately taken apart and things were removed from them. The researcher Matt LaCroix says so on Michels's show, telling it on his own account without naming a source, and says he has found very compelling evidence that it happened, which would mean someone has been hiding traces of the deep past.
